description: Bornes de recharge DBT – Mairie de Divonne-les-Bains is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nordine EL AMIRI. 2 bornes de recharges marque DBT modèle TINY avec chacune 1 point de charge DC 25kW et 1 point de charge AC 22kW et une prise domestique. Elles sont situées sur le parking public de la mairie de Divonne-les-Bains au 73 avenue des Thermes 01220 ouverte au public. Coverage: Nordine EL AMIRI. The publisher named on the listing is Nordine EL AMIRI. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, espace-public, irve-stations-de-recharge. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-10-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
